facts.text: The hotel offers ski-in/ski-out access to Northstar.
facts.excerpt: Step straight from your room onto the mountain with ski-in/ski-out access to Northstar

facts.text: The Highlands Gondola connects the hotel with Northstar Village.
facts.excerpt: The Highlands Gondola provides a scenic and convenient connection between Northstar Village and the hotel.

facts.text: The gondola is complimentary, runs year-round and needs no reservation.
facts.excerpt: the gondola offers a complimentary unique and easy way to access the resort year-round, and no reservation is required

facts.text: The hotel opened in 2009 and is set in a thick pine forest.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 2009, it’s set in a thick pine forest.

facts.text: Rooms have gas fireplaces, floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies with views of the mountain and Martis Valley.
facts.excerpt: Rooms in modern woodsy colors have dark-brown leather armchairs, floor-to-ceiling windows, gas fireplaces, and private balconies with views of the mountain and Martis Valley.

facts.text: Suites and Residences offer up to four bedrooms and living spaces such as kitchens and dining areas.
facts.excerpt: Suites and Residences offer up to four bedrooms and living spaces such as kitchens and dining areas.

facts.text: Manzanita is the hotel's slopeside signature restaurant, serving modern American cuisine with a regional mountain influence.
facts.excerpt: slopeside signature restaurant in Truckee serving modern American cuisine with a regional mountain influence

facts.text: Guests can dine in a Veuve Clicquot Cabana Chalet at The Backyard.
facts.excerpt: dine in a Veuve Clicquot Cabana Chalet at The Backyard, amid Tahoe scenery

facts.text: The hotel offers private mountainside firepits that guests can reserve for roasting marshmallows and making s'mores.
facts.excerpt: Warm up after an adventurous day of skiing with your own private firepit, perfect for roasting marshmallows, crafting s'mores

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa has fireplace-warmed relaxation areas, a dry-heat lodge and a eucalyptus steam room.
facts.excerpt: relaxation areas warmed by fireplaces, a dry-heat lodge, and a eucalyptus steam room

facts.text: Resort guests have access to the Lake Club, with lakefront amenities including an outdoor whirlpool, fireplaces, beach access and a private pier.
facts.excerpt: Lake Club is custom designed for resort guests to enjoy indoor and outdoor lakefront amenities, including an outdoor whirlpool, cozy fireplaces, showers and changing facilities, beach access and a private pier.

facts.text: Complimentary kayaks and standup paddle boards are provided for guests at the Lake Club.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary kayaks and standup paddle boards are provided for guest use

facts.text: Ritz Kids is a children's program with locally inspired environmental and cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids®, a program specially designed to bring Lake Tahoe to life with locally inspired environmental and cultural experiences

facts.text: The hotel has Topgolf Swing Suites with private simulators.
facts.excerpt: The Topgolf Swing Suites offer year-round fun with private simulators

facts.text: Most activities and dining at the hotel are by reservation only.
facts.excerpt: Most activities and dining are by reservation only.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking.
facts.excerpt: Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, our luxury Lake Tahoe hotel Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Rooms have gas fireplaces, contemporary mountain decor and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: feature gas fireplaces, contemporary mountain décor and floor-to-ceiling windows
